frontier.hypothesis: The last two missing insns are the target's tail-block `lhu` of D_800A3558 and its in-body `sll 16 / sra 16` sign-extension, and the discriminator is basic-block placement rather than the symbol's declared type.
frontier.mechanism: combine folds a sign_extend into a zero-extending load only when both insns live in the same basic block. The target's zero-extending load sits in the loop tail block at 80070ECC and its sign-extension at 80070E78/E7C in the next iteration's body, so the fold cannot fire. Every declaration spelling measured so far keeps both in the body block (s2 K1, s3 K4, s4 K7 all byte-neutral).
frontier.next_probe: Read the .combine dump for the fold at the D_800A3558 body read before spelling anything. Then look for a byte-faithful source shape that puts the zero-extended value's definition in the tail block: a variable whose live range crosses the loop back-edge (read at the bottom of iteration N, consumed at the top of iteration N+1), or a re-spelling of the loop-continuation test that makes CSE keep the body's read in the condition block. Note the target loads the SAME address twice in that block (lhu then lh), so the source almost certainly has two distinct reads with different signedness in different places, not one.

frontier.hypothesis: The residual at floor 56 is a clean 5-seat callee-saved rotation with no spurious allocno, so tools/ra_solver can type it REACHABLE or FORECLOSED and rank C levers instead of more hand spelling.
frontier.mechanism: local-alloc / global-alloc seat assignment. Target: arg0=$s1, var_s0=$s0, var_s3=$s3, ctx_or_var_s2=$s2, c60=$s4. Until this session the comparison was polluted by the extra reduced-giv allocno, which is why s1/s2's H4 never got a clean answer; that allocno is gone now.
frontier.next_probe: Run `tools/ra_solver/inverse_compose.py classify` on the floor-56 chassis (memory/grind/func_80070C70/candidate.c applied to src/text1b.c) and follow the ranked lever vector; use tools/sweep_variants.py for whatever spelled forms it names.

frontier.hypothesis: RecC70's and IconC70's real field lists are recoverable from their other consumers, replacing the two placeholder declarations that block submission independently of the floor.
frontier.mechanism: Carried unspent from s1/s2/s3. The 2-byte stride and the 0x20 size are proven by the target's addressing and frame arithmetic, but a one-member struct and an `s16 sp50[12]` tail are spellings of those facts, not evidence for them.
frontier.next_probe: Read the %hi/%lo(D_800A3590) and base-register accesses in func_8006F100, func_80070188, func_80070F78 and src/text1b_b.c:271 for RecC70; read the $a1-relative stores in func_8006B120, func_8006CFBC, func_800720FC, func_80074488 and func_8006F97C for IconC70's tail. Keep the census row's `alias of g_replay_motion_shared_state_d+6` suffix. If the consumers show a bare halfword array with no record structure, emit a ruling-request naming the family before any submission.
